test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

It is time to have tea.

options.text: Time must be taken to prepare tea.
It is time for tea to be had.
Tea is to be taken by it.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "It is time to have tea."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "tea" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "to have" to "to be had" (infinitive passive).
 
• Ensure the time phrase "It is time for" remains at the beginning of the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"It is time for tea to be had."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"Tea is to be had." – Does not include the time aspect.
 
• **Option 2: **"Time must be taken to prepare tea." – Changes the meaning of the sentence.
 
• **Option 4: **"Tea is to be taken by it." – Incorrect structure and meaning.
